fact: The DGSN's bilan for 2023 states that its technical services completed the generalisation of GESTARR, the police-arrondissement management system, across a national total of 454 police arrondissements, and connected it to a new system for managing the criminal and misdemeanour cases handled by arrondissements, then in experimental use in 350 police posts in the préfectures de police of Kénitra, Tanger, Meknès, Marrakech and Settat and the Sûreté provinciale of Safi.
title: Maroc: La DGSN dresse son bilan pour 2023
